stories.h: Port of Everett, Weyerhaeuser go to trial over cleanup costs
stories.s: A roughly four-week bench trial opened over who pays to clean up the old Mill A waterfront site. Ecology has pulled $87 million in grants, and Weyerhaeuser now argues the port should cover 80%.

stories.h: Lynnwood raises property taxes to ease budget gap
stories.s: The council unanimously used its banked tax capacity, raising about $2.2 million a year. The average homeowner will pay roughly $128 more starting in 2027. Final budget approval is set for Nov. 23.

stories.h: Everett voters ban officials from holding two elected offices
stories.s: About 93% backed barring Everett's mayor and council members from holding another elected post. A Snohomish County plan for nonpartisan county races was losing about 70-30.

stories.h: Judge dismisses suit over Everett waterfront train death
stories.s: A federal judge ruled for Everett, the county, BNSF and Amtrak in the 2024 death of a woman struck while crossing tracks near Harborview Park. The judge found the city and county had no duty to protect her.

stories.h: Firefighters rescue woman from Monroe house fire
stories.s: Snohomish Regional Fire & Rescue pulled a woman from a smoke-filled home Tuesday night. Crews kept the garage fire from spreading, and no one was hurt. The fire marshal is investigating.

coming.h: 212th St SW near Arlington closed through Thursday
coming.s: The road is fully closed between Sill and Knutson roads until 6 p.m. Nov. 12 for BNSF crossing work. Local and emergency traffic can use a gravel detour.

coming.h: Queen Nation tribute at Everett's APEX
coming.s: The Queen tribute band plays APEX's Kings Hall at 8 p.m.

coming.h: 'Ragtime' closes at Everett Performing Arts Center
coming.s: Sunday is the final day of the musical's run in Everett.
